pull_requests.head: 18-authentication
pull_requests.title: Student, teacher and admin authentication on Neon

issues.title: Verify the complete assessment journey
issues.body: Check navigation, answer persistence, submission retries, saved results and mobile layout

issues.title: Build personalised next-study recommendations
issues.body: Display recommended theories and resources returned by Python, with links to begin studying

issues.title: Display student success-rate statistics per question
issues.body: Show percentage correct and sample size; display “Insufficient data” when needed

issues.title: Build question-by-question review interface
issues.body: Show the student’s answer, correct answer, explanation, tested concept and related learning resource

issues.title: Build assessment result-summary page
issues.body: Display marks, percentage, topic performance and concepts suggested for revision

issues.title: Integrate exam submission with Python analysis API
issues.body: Submit the session, show analysis progress, handle failures and open saved results

issues.title: Build exam interface with answer persistence
issues.body: Display questions and options, navigation, answered indicators and timer; preserve answers after refresh

issues.title: Build assessment instructions page
issues.body: Display duration, question count, marking rules and a button to begin

issues.title: Build subject and assessment-paper selection pages
issues.body: Filter papers by selected source and subject; display paper details and availability

issues.title: Build learning-source selection page
issues.body: Display Enrolled Classes, Tuition Providers and Free Resources; show available sources and empty states

issues.title: Build Self-Assessment entry page
issues.body: Explain the assessment process and the feedback students receive; provide a start button

issues.title: Build Teso homepage with Exams section
issues.body: Include navigation, introduction, student benefits and an Exams section; the main assessment button scrolls to that section

issues.title: P0 Student, teacher and admin authentication - NextJs
issues.body: Users can sign in; the server enforces their roles; teacher access requires an invitation or approval

issues.title: Add 7-day and 14-day retention testing
issues.body: Track whether students retain knowledge after the scheduled review intervals.

issues.title: Build memory re-test workflow
issues.body: Automatically trigger revision questions when FSRS determines that a concept should be reviewed.

issues.title: Build student performance dashboard
issues.body: Display accuracy, weak topics, progress, revision tasks, and retention information.

issues.title: Build post-question explanation system
issues.body: Show targeted explanations when students answer questions incorrectly.

issues.title: Build adaptive practice session
issues.body: Create the student interface for completing questions selected by the revision engine.

issues.title: Create revision schedule generator
issues.body: Generate personalized revision tasks based on weak topics and upcoming FSRS review dates.

issues.title: Implement FSRS integration
issues.body: Integrate FSRS to schedule future reviews based on predicted memory retention.

issues.title: Implement response-time analysis
issues.body: Use response latency alongside correctness to identify patterns such as fast wrong answers and slow wrong answers.

issues.title: Implement weak-topic detection
issues.body: Identify the student's weakest topics using recent performance and mastery scores.

issues.title: Implement adaptive question selector
issues.body: Create the engine that selects the next question based on student mastery, question difficulty, and previous performance.

issues.title: Implement BKT student mastery tracking
issues.body: Implement Bayesian Knowledge Tracing to estimate a student's mastery for each topic/sub-topic.

issues.title: Build educator item-performance API
issues.body: Provide cohort-level statistics for educators, including question accuracy and failure rates.

issues.title: Build student performance aggregation
issues.body: Create APIs/services that aggregate accuracy, attempts, response time, topic performance, and subject performance.

issues.title: Calculate question facility percentage
issues.body: Calculate the percentage of students who correctly answer each question for peer-comparison diagnostics.

issues.title: Implement question difficulty calculation
issues.body: Implement the baseline Elo/Rasch model to dynamically estimate question difficulty.
